title: Built my own tool to turn trading ideas into backtest reports (Update)
author: DeepParticular8251
selftext:
I've been building a tool for myself (I call it Coin AI) that turns plain-English trading ideas into backtest reports, without writing any code.

The problem I kept running into was that I'd have a trading idea, but testing it properly meant writing code, setting up data, defining the rules, running the backtest, and then manually digging through the results. I wanted a faster way to go from idea → backtest → report → refine.

So I built a backtest engine where I can type a strategy in plain English and get a report back.

[Demo: Coin AI turning a plain-English prompt into a Bitcoin RSI backtest report.](https://reddit.com/link/1u7pbnb/video/oyn8j5xjcp7h1/player)

Right now it generates things like a performance summary, equity curve, trades, drawdowns, and a strategy breakdown.

I'm not trying to build a magic AI trading bot or claim this finds alpha. I'm building it because I personally want a faster way to research strategies, compare ideas, understand risk, and avoid relying on gut feeling before testing something.

Long term, I want it to become more of a strategy research engine: research assets, test ideas, compare results, refine assumptions, and eventually paper trade or deploy strategies with risk controls.

Some things I'm thinking about adding next:

* clearer fee/slippage assumptions
* walk-forward or out-of-sample testing
* benchmark comparison
* strategy comparison
* more assets like stocks, ETFs, prediction markets, options, and futures
* a way to inspect or edit the exact rules the AI created
* better explanations of why a strategy worked or failed

I mainly built this for myself, but if other people have the same problem and want to try it, it's completely free. I'm just looking for people to test it and give honest feedback.

If you are interested in using this, sign up for the waitlist at [trycoin.ai](http://trycoin.ai) and DM me (I'll get you off the waitlist and set up).

I'd love feedback on:

* Would you use something like this?
* What would you need to see to trust the backtest?
* What assumptions should always be visible?
* What feels missing from the demo?

Happy to answer any questions!

comments.author: 3BBBUrf
comments.body: De punten die je aangeeft, voor mijn testen zijn het vooral de slippages, bijvoorbeeld 4 keer een winst pakken in dezelfde minuut.. omdat die de Target in dezelfde minuut neemt. Vindt je opzet zeker interessant, wel is het zo, AI is niet de heilige graal. We moeten altijd zelf ingrijpen. Bijvoorbeeld hij detecteer een Entry, de volgende minuut een Reversal, en je trade gaat Bullish zit je gevangen in een Bearisch fuik en mis je soms 2-3 Candles.
